---
title: "ibm_verify_events_raw.application_usage"
description: "One row per IBM Verify SSO event, when someone reaches an application."
---

Every IBM Verify `sso` event: one row each time someone who is signed in reaches
an integrated application. Prefer the daily summary,
[`events_app_login_counts`](../ibm_verify_events_transformed/events_app_login_counts.qmd).

`Keywords`: SSO events, application usage, applications, relying parties, idle accounts, raw events

## Provenance

Pulled hourly from IBM Verify by the [streaming
job](https://github.com/cds-snc/canadalogin-reporting-data-pipeline/blob/main/infra/modules/ibm_verify_events_streaming/glue_src/ibm_verify_events_streaming_etl.py).
See [IBM Verify Events](../ibm_verify_events_raw.qmd) for what is hashed and
how to filter by day.

* **Updated**: Hourly
* **Retention**: 3 years
* **Steward**: EDCP Data and Research Team
* **Contact**: [Yinlin Zhang](mailto:yinlin.zhang@cds-snc.ca)
* **Location**: `s3://<raw-bucket>/ibm_verify_events_raw/application_usage/`

## Fields

One row per event.

| Field Name | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| time | string | When the event happened, in UTC (for example, "2026-09-15 00:00:05 UTC") |
| userid | string | Hashed user ID. Can be `"UNKNOWN"` |
| username | string | Hashed username |
| applicationid | string | IBM Verify's numeric ID for the application |
| applicationname | string | Application name (for example, "IRIS - PRC - Prod"). Join to [`rp.alias`](../rp/alias.qmd) on this |
| result | string | "success" or "failure" |
| realm | string | IBM Verify directory. "cloudIdentityRealm", or "UNKNOWN" when the account is not found |
| origin | string | Hashed client IP address |
| geoip__country_iso_code | string | Country from the IP address, as ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 (for example, "CAN") |
| geoip__country_name | string | Country name from the IP address |
| geoip__region_name | string | Province, territory, or state from the IP address |
| year | string | Partition key. UTC year, for example "2026" |
| month | string | Partition key. UTC month, for example "09" |
| day | string | Partition key. UTC day of the month, for example "15" |

## Notes

**Failed events rarely have a user.** In September 2026, 17,650 of 17,674
failures had `userid = "UNKNOWN"`.

**Flow Application is CanadaLogin's own.** Almost every new account reaches it
right after sign-up, which suggests it is the sign-up flow. It is an internal
application in [`rp.service`](../rp/service.qmd), so exclude internal
applications when the question is about partner services.

**Join to relying parties after, not before, aggregating.** See [Joining through
the lookup](../rp.qmd#joining-through-the-lookup).

**Example.** Distinct users who reached each application on an ET day:

```r
tbl(con, in_schema("ibm_verify_events_raw", "application_usage")) |>
  # partitions are UTC days, so read the next one too for the ET evening
  filter(year == "2026", month == "09", day %in% c("15", "16")) |>
  mutate(et_day = sql("date(with_timezone(CAST(substr(time, 1, 19) AS timestamp), 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE 'America/Toronto')")) |>
  filter(
    et_day == as.Date("2026-09-15"), result == "success",
    !is.na(userid), !userid %in% c("", "UNKNOWN")
  ) |>
  group_by(applicationname) |>
  summarise(unique_users = n_distinct(userid))
```
